GetDeviceDescription.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    getDescription: function() {
        var deviceSysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_device');
        var gr = new GlideRecord('u_ai_devices'); // your device table name

        return 'No description found';
    }
